text: FVLPD[p,mu,n,nb] denotes the positive component in the lightcone decomposition of the Lorentz vector p^{\mu } along the vectors n and nb in \(D\) dimensions. It corresponds to \(\frac{1}{2} \bar{n}^{\mu} (p \cdot n)\).
